$comment: The plain-English journeys Kane walks. Each is captured against the real Vikunja and then frozen as flows/<id>_test.md. Objectives: one line, no double quotes, visible-page checks only, ending on an outcome. {{amber_tag}} is six random letters supplied fresh for every run, so a write journey cannot pass on a replayed recording; every write journey ends with a reload and a check.
signIn: Go to http://127.0.0.1:4790/login. Sign in with username {{amber_user}} and password {{amber_password}} with Stay logged in ticked, then verify the home page greets Amber Demo.

journeys.title: Sign in
journeys.steps: Verify the home page lists the task Order tiles among the current tasks.
journeys.outcome: Home greets Amber Demo and lists current tasks

journeys.title: Projects page
journeys.steps: Open the Projects page from the main menu, then verify the projects Website relaunch, Kitchen renovation and Reading list are all shown.
journeys.outcome: The three projects are listed

journeys.title: Project list view
journeys.steps: Open the project Website relaunch, then verify its task list shows Write homepage copy, Set up analytics and Launch checklist.
journeys.outcome: Website relaunch lists its tasks

journeys.title: Task detail
journeys.steps: Open the project Website relaunch and open the task Set up analytics, then verify the task heading reads Set up analytics and the description mentions a privacy-friendly tool.
journeys.outcome: Task title and description shown

journeys.title: Table view
journeys.steps: Open the project Kitchen renovation and switch to its Table view, then verify a table lists Get three quotes, Order tiles and Book electrician.
journeys.outcome: Kitchen renovation tasks in table rows

journeys.title: Kanban view
journeys.steps: Open the project Kitchen renovation and switch to its Kanban view, then verify a board column is shown containing a card titled Choose worktop.
journeys.outcome: Kanban columns with task cards

journeys.title: Upcoming
journeys.steps: Open Upcoming from the main menu, then verify the tasks Order tiles and Review pricing page are listed.
journeys.outcome: Tasks due this week are listed

journeys.title: Search
journeys.steps: Use the search in the top bar to search for tiles, open the result Order tiles, then verify the task heading reads Order tiles.
journeys.outcome: Search finds and opens Order tiles

journeys.title: Add a task
journeys.steps: Open the project Kitchen renovation, add a new task titled Paint samples {{amber_tag}}, then verify Paint samples {{amber_tag}} appears in the project task list. Reload the page, then verify Paint samples {{amber_tag}} is still listed.
journeys.outcome: The new task is listed, and still listed after a reload

journeys.title: Mark a task done
journeys.steps: Open the project Kitchen renovation and mark the task Choose worktop as done with its checkbox. Reload the page, then verify Choose worktop is no longer in the list of open tasks and Order tiles still is.
journeys.outcome: The done task leaves the open list, after a reload

journeys.title: Rename a task
journeys.steps: Open the project Website relaunch and open the task Write homepage copy. Change its title to Homepage copy {{amber_tag}}. Go back to the Website relaunch list and verify Homepage copy {{amber_tag}} is listed. Reload the page, then verify Homepage copy {{amber_tag}} is still listed.
journeys.outcome: The new title is listed, and still listed after a reload

journeys.title: Edit a description
journeys.steps: Open the project Kitchen renovation and open the task Choose worktop. Set its description to Oak or quartz {{amber_tag}} and save it. Reload the page, then verify the description Oak or quartz {{amber_tag}} is shown.
journeys.outcome: The new description is still there after a reload

journeys.title: Delete a task
journeys.steps: Open the project Website relaunch and open the task Pick a colour palette. Delete the task and confirm. Verify the Website relaunch list no longer shows Pick a colour palette. Reload the page, then verify Pick a colour palette is still gone and Set up analytics is still listed.
journeys.outcome: The task is gone from the list, and still gone after a reload

journeys.title: Create a project
journeys.steps: Create a new project named Garden {{amber_tag}}. Open the Projects page from the main menu and verify Garden {{amber_tag}} is listed. Reload the page, then verify the Projects page still lists Garden {{amber_tag}} as well as Kitchen renovation.
journeys.outcome: The new project is listed, and still listed after a reload

journeys.title: Comment on a task
journeys.steps: Open the project Kitchen renovation and open the task Get three quotes. Add the comment Third quote {{amber_tag}}, then verify the comments show both Third quote {{amber_tag}} and Two quotes in so far. Reload the page, then verify Third quote {{amber_tag}} is still shown.
journeys.outcome: The new comment shows beside the existing one, and after a reload

journeys.title: Open a new task
journeys.steps: Open the project Kitchen renovation, add a new task titled Order grout {{amber_tag}}, then open the task Order grout {{amber_tag}} and verify its page shows the title Order grout {{amber_tag}}. Reload the page, then verify the title Order grout {{amber_tag}} is still shown.
journeys.outcome: A new task opens on its own page, and again after a reload

journeys.title: New task on the home page
journeys.steps: Open the project Kitchen renovation and add a new task titled Call plumber {{amber_tag}}. Open Overview from the main menu, then verify Call plumber {{amber_tag}} is listed under Current Tasks. Reload the page, then verify Call plumber {{amber_tag}} is still listed under Current Tasks.
journeys.outcome: A new task is listed on the home page, and after a reload

journeys.title: Search for a new task
journeys.steps: Open the project Kitchen renovation and add a new task titled Buy sealant {{amber_tag}}. Use the search in the top bar to search for {{amber_tag}}, open Buy sealant {{amber_tag}} from the results, then verify its page shows the title Buy sealant {{amber_tag}}. Reload the page, then verify the title Buy sealant {{amber_tag}} is still shown.
journeys.outcome: Search finds a new task and opens it

journeys.title: Done moves to the Done column
journeys.steps: Open the project Kitchen renovation and open the task Choose worktop. Click Mark task done!, then open the Kanban view of Kitchen renovation and verify Choose worktop is in the Done column. Reload the page, then verify Choose worktop is still in the Done column and Order tiles is in the To-Do column.
journeys.outcome: A task marked done shows in the Kanban Done column, after a reload

journeys.title: Favourite a project
journeys.steps: In the main menu on the left, hover over the project Reading list and click the star button beside its name, labelled Mark this project as favorite; do not star any task. Then verify Reading list is listed as a favorite project in the main menu. Reload the page, then verify Reading list is still listed as a favorite project.
journeys.outcome: A favourite project stays a favourite after a reload

journeys.title: Label a task
journeys.steps: Open the project Kitchen renovation and open the task Order tiles. Add a new label named Urgent {{amber_tag}} to the task, then verify the task shows the label Urgent {{amber_tag}}. Reload the page, then verify the label Urgent {{amber_tag}} is still shown on the task.
journeys.outcome: A new label shows on the task, and after a reload
